title: The Andhra Pradesh Grama Sachivalayams and Ward Sachivalayams (GSWS) Act, 2023.
full_text: The Andhra Pradesh Grama Sachivalayams and Ward Sachivalayams (GSWS) Act, 2023. ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ గ్రామ సచివాలయములు మరియు వార్డు సచివాలయముల (జిఎస్ డబ్ల్యు ఎస్) చట్టము, 2023 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202323 Act Number: 23 Enactment Date: 2023-05-01 Act Year: 2023 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Grama Sachivalayams and Ward Sachivalayams (GSWS) Act, 2023. Hindi Title: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ గ్రామ సచివాలయములు మరియు వార్డు సచివాలయముల (జిఎస్ డబ్ల్యు ఎస్) చట్టము, 2023 Long Title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE A NEW STRUCTURE TO DELIVER INNUMERABLE OTHER CITIZEN CENTRIC SERVICES AND AMENITIES INCLUDING THE INDICATIVE LIST OF CITIZEN SERVICES MENTIONED IN THE 11TH SCHEDULE AND 12TH SCHEDULE OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA AND TO PROVIDE A STATUTORY FRAMEWORK FOR THE GRAMA SACHIVALAYAMS AND WARD SACHIVALAYAMS AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
